column1: # Hand-maintained corrections of LexiqueMixte.tsv rows (same format and replay as mixteCorrections.tsv, which is generated from
# the accepted decisions and must not be edited by hand; this file is the home of the rows found by hand). Loaded by
# `loadAllMixteCorrections` (src/mixtecorrections.py); a key present in both files, or matching no output row, fails the build.
# manual-stray-glide-i (2026-10-09): the 26 rows where Mixte had a stray `i` before the glide (`contorsionnait` ...sijonE, not ...sjonE;
#   `ij` -> `j`, `industrialis-` `ij` -> `i`), and `riant` Rj@ -> Rij@. Letters follow Lexique383 (no `=`); closed `O` kept.

# manual-dropped-schwa (2026-10-10): the 15 rows of `rejeter` (13 finite and participle forms, the infinitive) and `épousseter` (infinitive) where Lexique383 drops the stem schwa (`rejeta` R°Zta -> R°Z°ta, `épousseter` epuste -> epus°te; `rejetions` R°Z°tj§ has it);
#   (the other forms of `épousseter`, `époussetez` epus°te, have it); GLAFF lists the schwa variant of both.
# manual-arguer-gu (2026-10-10): ruling arguer [aRg8e]: the 6 finite and participle forms of `arguer` other than `argué` (already aRg8e) get the 8 after the g;
#   the `gu` letter unit splits g_u so that the units pair (as aiguille, linguiste). Applies decisions b3efd1782d and 64402d8bce.
# manual-decatie-t (2026-10-10): `décatie` (ADJ and the par:pas row) dekasi -> dekati (Lexique's s is a typo; the other forms have t).
# manual-loanword-units (2026-10-10): the loanword rows where Lexique's phon is kept and syll_cv / orthosyll_cv are rebuilt to carry exactly its sounds
#   with paired units (`=` repeats the previous letter unit for a glide or a repeated sound; `#` marks a silent letter). Skipped: etc, mm (abbreviations of et cetera / millimetre).
